LanguageData.LP_FeatInspire.label: inspire
LanguageData.LP_FeatInspire.description: Inspiring Leader feat: allies within 10 cells (including yourself) get an "Inspired" shield for 1 day that absorbs 20 + 3 × level + 5 × Charisma modifier damage, and mood +5 (half a day). 2 uses per day, restored at midnight.
